text:
sam: heads up — deploybot blocked the staging->prod promotion for image `service-api:2026-03-20_17:12` — provenance attestation missing for digest sha256:abc123... wondering if we should rollback prod pin or try an ephemeral republish during the change window.

maria: looking at the ECR push logs now. quick snippet:```
2026-03-20T17:13:02Z ERROR push: attestation not found for sha256:abc123
2026-03-20T17:13:03Z INFO upload complete (manifest exists)
2026-03-20T17:13:03Z WARN deploybot: blocking publish due to missing provenance
```

jonathan: are we sure it's the attestation TTL or did cosign fail to sign? can we re-run the signing step with the same build-id?

maria: cosign returned 500 from KMS when trying to attach sig; KMS logs show transient auth error around 17:12. no sign was created.

lina: if we re-run signing we might generate a different timestamp/signature which could break the pining in deploybot that expects original buildid metadata. risk of mismatch.

sam: deploybot options? can we bypass attestation requirement temporarily for this run and then clean up?

deploybot: automatic message — Deploy blocked: provenance check failed for image sha256:abc123. Options: `--force-promote` (requires SRE approval), `--pin-to-digest <digest>`, or rollback to prior digest. Recommending rollback if provenance cannot be recovered within change window.

jonathan: i'm +1 for rollback to previous digest for prod. We can republish an ephemeral signed image to staging for QA and ship a follow-up patch with the signed image.

lina: agree. Proposed steps:
1) pin prod to previous digest `sha256:deadbeef` and promote (safe rollback).
2) republish signed build for the broken build (ephemeral tag `2026-03-20-ephemeral`) in staging only.
3) update release notes and create a follow-up ticket to reconcile buildids and attestations.

sam: timeline — change window closes in 45m. we need an SRE ack to allow rollback now. @ops-bot can you trigger the rollback play?

ops-bot: pinging oncall SRE. @oncall-sre please review: deploying rollback to digest `sha256:deadbeef` for service-api in prod. Reason: missing provenance for candidate image.

ops-bot: oncall responded — "approve rollback; we should avoid `--force-promote`."

maria: i'll run the deploybot pin command for prod once we confirm the digest. Command I'll run (dry-run first):```
deploybot promote --service service-api --from-tag 2026-03-20_17:12 --to-digest sha256:deadbeef --env prod --dry-run
```

sam: once dry-run looks good, execute for real and scale canary to 0%. after rollback completes, i'll open the follow-up ticket and update release-notes.md with a short note about the missing attestation and remediation steps.

deploybot: executing: `promote --service service-api --to-digest sha256:deadbeef --env prod` — will perform canary stepdown: 10% -> 0% then verify healthchecks. ETA 4m.

maria: dry-run passed. healthchecks for previous digest look sane in staging (latency/5xx within normal).

sam: confirmed, proceeding. lina, jonathan — do you want ownership of the ephemeral republish and follow-up?

jonathan: i can take the ephemeral republish and QA verification in staging. i'll attempt to re-run the signing pipeline but will create a new image tag if the original buildid can't be preserved.

lina: i'll own the follow-up ticket and release-notes entry. adding checklist: KMS error investigation, CI retry policy, deploybot preflight doc update.

ops-bot: rollback started. rolling back prod to sha256:deadbeef. canary scaled to 0%. Will post result. :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks everyone. quick note for release notes: "Rollback: prod pinned to previous image after failed provenance sign on candidate; staging will host ephemeral signed build for verification; follow-up ticket created." i'll post the ticket link here after it's created. :thumbsup:

deploybot: rollback completed successfully at 2026-03-20T17:24:59Z. Prod healthchecks green.

maria: created ticket INFRA-2421: "Investigate transient KMS auth failures causing cosign attestations to fail" and added the release-notes draft in the ticket.

jonathan: republish attempt started in staging with tag `2026-03-20-ephemeral` — will report if signing succeeds.

lina: updating release-notes.md now and notifying PMs.

sam: closing thread once ephemeral signs or we hit change window. thanks all.
